bias.label: Leaning down below 4,050 after hot CPI

event: US PPI later this week (date and SAST time UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Selling kept going
bullets.text: Gold was 4,019.80 at 19:30 SAST, down 119.60 (-2.89%) on the day, with a range of 4,012.70 to 4,147.40 (Kitco).

bullets.title: Support broke
bullets.text: Monday's low near 4,053 and the 4,030 zone from this afternoon both gave way, so they now sit overhead as resistance.

bullets.title: CPI came hot
bullets.text: October CPI rose 0.4% m/m against 0.3% expected, and core rose 0.3% against 0.2% expected (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Hike odds high
bullets.text: Markets price about an 84% chance of a December Fed hike, and Governor Waller said he would back a 50bp hike if inflation keeps rising (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Dollar stronger
bullets.text: The dollar index is near 102.36, up about 0.7%, and the US yield shown by Trading Economics is near 5.02% (which maturity is UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Round number next
bullets.text: 4,000 is the next clear support from earlier analysis (TradingKey) and a big round number where buyers and stop runs often meet.

levels.note: Kitco 4,019.80 and Trading Economics 4,020.34 at about 19:30 SAST

buy.title: Buy plan (counter-trend): dip that holds 4,000
look: This is counter-trend after a near 3% drop, so use half size.
A wick under 4,000 that closes back above it on the 15M.
The dollar index fading back below 102.
No entry while candles are still long and fast.
watch: Buying at 4,020 because it looks cheap, with no zone and no stop.
There is no confirmed support below 4,000, so a break can run fast.
Fed speakers or US PPI can add more hike talk and more selling.
Moving your stop lower when price gets close. That is how a small loss becomes a big one.

sell.title: Sell plan: rejection at 4,030-4,053
look: A bounce into 4,030-4,053 that fails, not a sell at 4,020 near the low.
A clear 15M rejection wick or bearish close inside the zone.
The dollar index holding near 102.3 or higher.
Take some profit at 4,030 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Chasing the drop by selling at 4,020 just above the 4,013 low and 4,000.
After a near 3% fall, short-covering can spike price through 4,062.
US-Iran or other headlines can bring safe-haven buying back fast.
Re-entering again and again after being stopped out. One attempt, then step away.
